anchor_repairs.method: Variance factor t*(17/20, -1/20, 53/100) on the fibre coordinates (6, 7, 10) (the retry family of rows 16-18, data/cap-recipes/row16.json), t chosen per node as the accepted amplitude with the largest exact Schur margin of the checker matrix N (same functions as nodeOK, grid 1); nodes whose stored recipe fails by less than 1e-6 keep it and move to the fine grid (1600, 1024, 1/200) of the certificate catalogue. Each repaired anchor is verified by its per-node rangeOK probe (native_decide) before the push; CI certifies the range facts.

scope: Unverified anchored recipe proposals only, following a complete exact-zero per-row input gate. No native verification, activation, global capsRest discharge or cache claim.
